title: What Bedding Through Yonder Trapdoor Rises!

contact_edits.before: Revving up the violence is another thing, but it's also the easy part. Romeo and Juliet was, as far as we can tell, the first full-blooded play about romantic love; Shakespeare in Love got that right. It remains, by centuries of consent, the iconic one. There's an audience out there, new with each generation, that wants to believe in it. - Romeo and Juliet runs until Nov. 8. For tickets and information call 1-800-567-1600 or visit stratfordfestival.ca
